{{Quote|I've got to send a message to those [*itches*] who sent me that lice infested cargo. And I want you to deliver it. Go to the Lok system and let that Kimogila battlelord know that I didn't appreciate his little surprise.|A [[Dathomir Station]] communications officer|<ref name="SWG:DtKB" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Darkscale''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a battlelord of the [[Kimogila Fanatics]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Captain Darkscale frequently piloted a [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]] in the [[Karthakk system]].<ref name="SWG:DtKB" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempGenericPirate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Captain Darkscale]]
Darkscale appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DtKB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Captain Darkscale was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DtKB" />
